description: Permanently delete files from your Besidka library, including files that are project knowledge (their extracted text is removed with them). The result lists the deleted ids and the skipped ones with a reason: not_found, or storage_error or error (try again). Files are deleted one at a time, so a failure part way keeps the files already deleted. Requires signing in (data:delete).

fileIds.description: File ids from list_files, up to 100 per call

name: delete_files
title: Delete files
